title: S3 uploadToS3 AccessDenied on resume upload

error_signal.message: vocator-backend AccessDenied: Access Denied when calling uploadToS3 for resume file storage

ground_truth.root_cause_description: S3 bucket policy or IAM role does not have PutObject permission. Infrastructure issue, not code bug.
ground_truth.fix_description: Check IAM role permissions and S3 bucket policy for PutObject access
